resolvedFindings.RE-060-001: Policy now applies a final structural-enterability gate to every READY_ACTION candidate using the existing lifecycle/prepared-reuse contract. Exact-same terminal revise corrections fail closed instead of advertising an Action Core cannot prepare.

decisions: A Policy READY_ACTION candidate must be structurally enterable from the exact current Action slot before it can be emitted.

For a null slot, structural entry reuses the existing lifecycle prepare transition; for prepared A, only exact A reuse is legal; for terminal A, structural entry reuses the existing lifecycle prepare transition.
Owner correction remains stage-bounded and revise-only, but exact same terminal revise targets are not immediately legal because current lifecycle rejects terminal A to prepare A.
The real 049 explore to 050 revise-explore correction remains legal because terminal explore and revise-explore are different Action identities.
If Owner wants the exact same revise Action again, Foundation must first pass through another different lifecycle Action; Policy does not invent retry, reset, resume, or terminal-loosening behavior.
